system.specialAbility:
You become Trained in Crafting and Insight, and you become Trained in a relevant Lore of your choice.

Example Lores include Calligraphy Lore, Bookbinding Lore, Lore of a particular archive.
system.description: You copied and preserved documents, learning to recognize a careless source and mend a damaged page. Somewhere among other people's words, you found a matter that demanded action.
